name: CutScene
rows: Is this what they call... a K.O.?
I didn't even hit them yet... and off they flew...
One hit and it was over...
Whoops, did I send them flying a little too far?
Whoa there, Black Typhoon. Settle down.
You've never getting behind me if you can't take me down.
Think you can block this one too?
I'd be careful if I were you, unless you wanna get burned.
